title: 2006 Omineca Agriculture Development Areas and Settlement Reserve Areas Order
transcribedFrom: signed PDF, scanned; read from the page images

provisions.heading: Preamble
quotes: This order establishes land use objectives for agricultural development areas and settlement reserve areas within 4 forest
These land use objectives were developed using the social direction of the Land and Resource Management Plans
These plans are designed to provide an appropriate balance of social, economic and environmental benefits

provisions.heading: Objectives established for ADAs and SRAs
quotes: land use objectives are established for all agriculture development areas (ADA's) and settlement reserve areas (SRA's)
Pursuant to section 93.4 of the Land Act (the Act), land use objectives are established for all agriculture development
James Forest District 2.

provisions.heading: Land use objectives (chapeau)
quotes: timber is to be managed subject to the following conditions and practices:
In recognition of the economic potential of agriculture development areas and settlement reserve areas

provisions.heading: Harvesting For Environmental and Safety Reasons
quotes: Harvesting For Environmental and Safety Reasons Harvesting is permitted for environmental and safety reasons

provisions.heading: Forest Practices Around Forest Health
quotes: Forest Practices Around Forest Health Harvesting is permitted for activities under the Bark Beetle Regulation
There must be a clear indication that forest health sanitation harvesting will significantly assist in preventing the spread

provisions.heading: Conditions Applicable to Part B (chapeau)
quotes: Each of the following conditions apply to forest practices permitted under Part B:
Conditions Applicable to Part B.

provisions.heading: Dead or infested timber only
quotes: Removal of dead or infested timber only

provisions.heading: Minimum stump height
quotes: Harvested stumps must have a MINIMUM 15 cm (6 inch) stump height to facilitate future stump removal for agricultural
Stump height can be less than 15 cm. to meet operational requirements for any of the following: access to and from the cut

provisions.heading: Piling and disposal of logging waste
quotes: Logging waste and residue must not be distributed across the cut block, but is to be piled and then appropriately disposed

provisions.heading: Permanent access minimized
quotes: Permanent access development, including gravelling, is to be minimized, and as much as possible located along lot lines and

provisions.heading: No site preparation or artificial regeneration
quotes: No activities related to site preparation and artificial regeneration

provisions.heading: Referral to the Ministry of Agriculture and Lands
quotes: All harvesting proposals to be referred to the Ministry of Agriculture and Lands.

provisions.heading: Area Based Forest Tenures
quotes: No area based forest tenures will be established within these agricultural development areas and settlement reserve areas.
Area Based Forest Tenures 1.

provisions.heading: Deviations from Parts A, B, C and D
quotes: Deviations from Parts A, B, C and D Deviations may include the following:
Limited and conditional salvage and/ or harvest opportunities as determined by Ministry of Agriculture and Lands
Adjustments may be required for activities resulting from practices pursuant to Ministry of Agriculture and Lands Crown Land

provisions.heading: Crown land only; permits and schedules in effect
quotes: This order applies only to Crown land and does not affect any of the following that are in effect at the beginning of the
1. a cutting permit 2. a road permit 3. a timber sale licence that does not provide for cutting permits 4. an area described

provisions.heading: Effective date
quotes: this order takes effect on the date on which it is published in the Gazette.
Despite Section 16 (2) of the Forest and Range Practices Act, this order takes effect on the date on which it is published

provisions.heading: Applicable period for FSP amendment (FRPA s. 8)
quotes: For the purposes of Section 8 of the Forest and Range Practices Act, the applicable period is 6 months.
